blockers.error: CID 1271 (dnxhr_hqx, 10-bit): decode follows ST 2019-1 Table C.2 (weights Table D.1); the ffmpeg-written fixture decodes up to 4 LSB away from ffmpeg and further from the encoder source (MSE 0.19 vs 0.05). With Table D.4 weights the same bytes land within 2 LSB of ffmpeg and closer to the source (MSE 0.045), so ffmpeg uses D.4-like luma weights for 1271. Studio keeps the standard; 10-bit agreement with ffmpeg is NOT_PROVEN. Lead decision needed: keep D.1 (standard) or follow the observed weights; an Avid/Adobe-written 1271 file would settle it (UNVERIFIED).
